subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should a zero- or low-overlap Skill Workshop update override the shipped `auto` approval policy and require explicit operator approval?
rationale: The automatic default was an intentional workflow choice; converting content similarity into an approval-policy boundary changes existing operator behavior and cannot be settled by tests alone.

options.title: Require approval for risky replacements
options.body: Keep automatic approval for ordinary updates but force explicit approval when the proposal has insufficient meaningful overlap with the current skill.

options.title: Preserve automatic approval
options.body: Reject structurally invalid proposals but allow all structurally valid updates to retain the current automatic approval behavior.

options.title: Require approval for every update
options.body: Make all destructive Skill Workshop updates pending regardless of content similarity, accepting the workflow regression for a simpler safety rule.

recommendation.title: Require approval for risky replacements
recommendation.body: Keep automatic approval for ordinary updates but force explicit approval when the proposal has insufficient meaningful overlap with the current skill.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged change established the current automatic approval behavior this decision would qualify.
